# Bhartiya Nikoo Homes 8

> Studio to 4 BHK homes and a limited courtyard villa release by Bhartiya Urban at Bellahalli, off Thanisandra Main Road, North Bengaluru.

Bhartiya Nikoo Homes 8 (Bhartiya Garden Enclave) is an approximately 11.35-acre development of about 1,010 homes across six towers, launched on 17 June 2026, with a 40,000+ sq ft clubhouse (the Black Swan Club), about 75% open space and a car-free Central Spine. It is on a separate parcel about five to seven minutes from the Bhartiya City township — not inside it. Indicative launch prices run from about Rs 67 lakh (studio) to about Rs 2.94 crore (4 BHK + staff). Karnataka RERA: Phase 1 PRM/KA/RERA/1251/309/PR/070526/008628, Phase 2 PRM/KA/RERA/1251/309/PR/070526/008629; RERA-filed completion December 2030.

This website is operated by Real Revenue, an authorised channel partner. It is not the official website of Bhartiya Urban. Prices are indicative and revised release to release.
